title: RoBERTa: A Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach
authors: Y. Liu, M. Ott, N. Goyal, et al. (10 authors)
before: BERT's recipe was taken as settled, and work moved to new architectures.
problem: Was BERT's ceiling architectural, or had it simply been undertrained?
breakthrough: Same architecture, more data, longer training, bigger batches, no next-sentence prediction. It beat every successor.
why: An early lesson that training recipe and data often matter more than architectural novelty.
next: The lesson resurfaces in Chinchilla and again in Llama's overtraining.
inherits: Scepticism about architecture claims that are really compute claims.
